critical_code_review_comments: HomeEquipmentBody.model_dump() in /auth/onboarding overwrites the entire user.profile — any previously-saved profile fields not in HomeEquipmentBody schema will be dropped on each save. Not a regression from this iteration, but worth noting as future maintenance risk.

route_focus, main_goal_key and job_title are free-form Optional[str] in HomeEquipmentBody — no server-side enum validation, so an arbitrary string is accepted (e.g. `route_focus='not_a_route'`). Current design relies on frontend chip picker to constrain values, which is fine for now, but a Pydantic Literal or validator would make the API safer.

In onboarding.tsx `p.experience_level` is used for state default but `feature_programme_quality._resolve_goal_key` reads `profile.experience` — check that both keys are consistent across the codebase to avoid target-per-week miscalculation for beginners/advanced users. (Not blocking this iteration; goal_key resolution itself is correct.)
